verdict_note: Strong GTM and positioning expertise with proven D2C funnel ownership, but lacks direct B2C fintech/payments experience and early-stage consumer product marketing at scale.

breakdown.note: Manager-level experience across GTM, product marketing, and growth; P&L ownership signals readiness for lead role, but no explicit PMM title or consumer-facing product marketing leadership at comparable scale.

Strong on GTM strategy, positioning, competitive intelligence, D2C funnel, KPI tracking, cross-functional leadership. Weaker on consumer research synthesis, brand partnership strategy, and consumer-specific growth metrics.

EdTech B2C SaaS experience is relevant for D2C motion and scaling, but lacks fintech, payments, or financial services background. Consumer wallet/digital payment dynamics are materially different from EdTech positioning.

Demonstrated 38% CAC lift, 40% retention improvement, 25% sales growth through repositioning, and cross-functional execution at scale. Lacks evidence of consumer research leadership, brand campaign influence, or consumer adoption metrics at 250M+ user scale.

Requires H1B sponsorship; Stripe is large enough to sponsor, but candidate is still in MBA program (graduating May 2027) and will not be job-ready until mid-2027. Timeline misalignment is a moderate risk.

top_signal: Proven ability to diagnose and fix leaky GTM funnels (38% CAC improvement), redesign positioning for messaging-market fit (25% sales growth), and own end-to-end D2C funnel with cross-functional leadership—directly transferable to Link's consumer growth challenge.
biggest_gap: No demonstrated experience in consumer-scale fintech, digital wallets, or payments; no direct track record building consumer research programs or influencing brand marketing campaigns; graduation timeline (May 2027) may not align with immediate hiring needs.
